summary: Frontend-only iteration-2 verification of the Cosift incremental update. Covered all 13 testpoints from the review request: Landing Sign-In CTA, GuestBanner on Reader & Personal, UpgradeSheet (google/apple/email), Personal tab rename, BUG-004 ::selection CSS, Share card flow with clipboard-blocked fallback. Backend skipped per request (iteration_1 still green). 11/13 testpoints exercised live via Playwright; the remaining 2 (PDF text-selection toolbar and the in-Reader 'highlight stored temporarily' toast) were verified by static inspection of /app/frontend/src/pages/Reader.jsx because they require text-extractable PDF content that the playwright harness cannot produce (the backend accepts the 14-byte stub but pdf.js raises InvalidPDFException, so there is no text layer to drag-select).

issues: Body copy duplicates words because the template ('Create an account to save {context}, highlights, reflections, saved words, and reading progress across devices.') is concatenated with a context string that already contains the same words. On Reader it reads: 'save highlights and reading, highlights, reflections, saved words, and reading progress…'. On Personal: 'save your reflections, saved words and reading, highlights, reflections, saved words, and reading progress…'. Either drop the context interpolation or pick disjoint phrases (e.g. context='your insights' which is the default — used by no caller).

action_items: Optional copy polish in UpgradeSheet: avoid duplicating 'highlights/saved words/reading' between the interpolated {context} and the fixed sentence.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.jsx startGoogleLogin builds the redirect_url from window.location.origin + returnPath — verified by clicking cta-sign-in on the live preview; the browser navigated to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=... (Emergent OAuth 'LOG IN TO Circle Reads' screen). Correct.

ShareCard fallback chain (Web Share API → ClipboardItem image → download+writeText link) is well-guarded: all three branches are wrapped in try/catch so a rejected navigator.clipboard.writeText cannot bubble into the React error boundary. R-3 verified empirically (override navigator.clipboard.writeText to reject, click share-card-copy-link → execCommand textarea fallback succeeds and 'Copied' badge renders, no webpack runtime-error overlay appears).

index.css ::selection rule has NO `color` property and the .react-pdf__Page__textContent ::selection rule sets color: transparent + -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent — BUG-004 / R-7 regression guard holds. Verified by walking document.styleSheets in the live page.

Reader.jsx, lines 387/396/415/429/452/467/485/486/502/510/511/536: pre-create toolbar exposes ONLY action-highlight and action-share (no Thought/Vocab buttons); post-create BottomSheet has data-testid='post-action-sheet' with post-add-reflection / post-start-discussion / post-save-word options; renamed sheet titles confirmed ('Add a reflection', save button 'Save reflection', 'Save a word', 'Discussion').
Reader.jsx line 128: remindGuest() toast template = 'Your ${kind} is stored temporarily on this device.' with a Sonner action labelled 'Save' that opens the UpgradeSheet — matches the spec verbatim.
CreateCircle.jsx wraps ShareCard with circleName/bookTitle/memberCount/inviteUrl/bookId; share-invite button only setShareCardOpen(true) — clean separation.
GuestBanner copy says 'Save your {context} across devices.' / 'Stored only on this device for now.' — matches spec.

Personal.jsx tabs use the renamed labels (Reflections / Saved Words / Insights) while keeping the original tab IDs (thoughts/vocabulary/insights) so the existing API endpoints (/my-thoughts, /vocabulary, /saved-insights) need not change. Good incremental refactor.

success_rate.frontend: 11/13 exercised live + 2/13 verified via static inspection = 100% spec coverage, 0 failures

test_credentials: Anonymous sessions only (POST /api/auth/anonymous). test_credentials.md remains empty — acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_PW_Circle / TEST_PW_Book and TEST_PW_R / TEST_PW_RBook circles+books for ShareCard + Reader flows. Anonymous users TEST_PWGuest, TEST_PWHost, TEST_PWReader. None auto-cleaned but all TEST_-prefixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All testids in the spec are wired. To exercise the floating PDF toolbar + the 'Your highlight is stored temporarily' Sonner toast you need a PDF with real, text-extractable content (the 14-byte stub causes pdf.js InvalidPDFException so the Page text layer is never built). One option: upload a real one-page PDF via fixtures, then use page.mouse.move/down/up across .react-pdf__Page__textContent span elements, and wait ~150ms before reading [data-testid='floating-toolbar']. The handler in Reader.jsx uses setTimeout(30) so a 200ms wait is safe. Alternative: dispatch a synthetic Selection by setting window.getSelection().setBaseAndExtent over a known span and dispatching 'mouseup' on the container, but be aware Reader.jsx reads selection text via window.getSelection().toString() inside its handler. Iteration-1 backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_cosift_api.py remain valid — DO NOT re-run unless backend code changed.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The minor UpgradeSheet copy duplication is a content/UX issue, not a functional defect — main agent may polish at will.
